name: AttackBox - Monthly account ingestion budget
description: Warn at 75 GB and escalate at 80 GB to preserve 20 GB of the 100 GB monthly allowance. Account-visible usage only; check organization-wide sharing. Reporting can lag about three hours. UI-only campaign policy; no automatic evidence drops or ingress changes.

nrql.query: FROM NrMTDConsumption SELECT latest(GigabytesIngested) WHERE productLine = 'DataPlatform'
